reusePolicy.selection: Deterministic task-context lookup; no random choice. Each task and its remediation retain the same photograph.
reusePolicy.drawing: Word Rescue, Academy, Action Detective, My Week and Exit use five distinct photographs. Named Mia story retains drawTrain.
reusePolicy.watching: Academy, Action Detective and My Week use three distinct new TV compositions; Word Rescue extra retains the original father/son photo.
reusePolicy.characters: Named Mia/Ben/Tom retain drawTrain/benClimb/tomHelp through Personality and Adventure. Generic climb/help use separate children and backgrounds.
reusePolicy.comparisons: Consecutive positive/negative/question comparisons within one teaching context intentionally reuse its photograph; same context remediation does too.
reusePolicy.otherActions: Core football/read/bike/homework images may recur in same-context comparison tasks; My Week uses distinct inspected owner originals.
reusePolicy.exit: Drawing Exit uses its own photograph; generic helpful-boy Exit reuses the vocabulary helping scene to assess the quality, without the story name.
